name: Eisinga Planetarium in Franeker
description: In the Frisian town of Franeker, a wool manufacturer named Eise Eisinga spent seven years, from 1774 to 1781, turning his own living room ceiling into a working model of the solar system. Driven by a single pendulum clock, the planets circle the Sun in real time at a true-to-scale spacing. It is regarded as the world's oldest working orrery, and you can still visit it today.
